title: "Report ISPE"
format: html
editor: visual
execute:
  message: false
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(omopgenerics)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(visOmopResults)
library(here)
library(rlang)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

resultG <- omopgenerics::importSummarisedResult(here::here("Results", "results_all_CPRD GOLD.csv"))

resG <- resultG |>
  settings() |>
  distinct(result_type) |>
  pull() |>
  set_names() |>
  map(\(x) {
    result |>
      filterSettings(result_type == x) |>
      tidy()
  })

resultA <- omopgenerics::importSummarisedResult(here::here("Results", "results_all_CPRD Aurum_v2.csv"))

resA <- resultA |>
  settings() |>
  distinct(result_type) |>
  pull() |>
  set_names() |>
  map(\(x) {
    result |>
      filterSettings(result_type == x) |>
      tidy()
  })

save(resA, resG, file = here::here("Results", "reportData.RData"))

load(file = here::here("Results", "reportData.RData"))

```

## Negative control outcomes

```{r, results='asis'}
x <- res$cox_regression |>
  filter(outcome_type == "nco") |>
  mutate(comparison_name = str_wrap(paste0(reference, " vs ", exposed), 20)) |>
  mutate(excludes_null = hr_lower > 1 | hr_upper < 1) |>
  filter(comparison_id %in% c(3, 4, 5))

boundary <- tibble(coef = seq(from = -2.3, to = 2.3, length.out = 101)) |>
  mutate(se_min = abs(coef) / 1.96)

tws <- unique(x$time_window)

for (tw in tws) {
  xw <- x |>
    filter(time_window == tw)
  print(
    ggplot(data = xw, aes(x = hr, y = se_coef)) +
      geom_ribbon(
        data = boundary,
        aes(x = exp(coef), ymin = 0, ymax = se_min),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        fill = "#F4A340",
        alpha = 0.55
      ) +
      geom_line(
        data = boundary,
        aes(x = exp(coef), y = se_min),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        colour = "#E87511",
        linewidth = 0.45
      ) +
      scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2)) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6)) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.5, 2), ylim = c(0, 0.6)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = "grey45", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_point(aes(colour = excludes_null), alpha = 0.55, size = 1.8) +
      scale_colour_manual(
        values = c("FALSE" = "#315A7D", "TRUE" = "#B23A48"),
        labels = c("FALSE" = "CI includes 1", "TRUE" = "CI excludes 1"),
        name = NULL,
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      facet_grid(weight_type ~ comparison_name) +
      labs(x = "Hazard ratio (log scale)", y = "Standard error of log(HR)", title = tw) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey88", linewidth = 0.25),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey88", linewidth = 0.25),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "grey20"),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.justification = "left",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 8, 5, 5)
      )
  )
}

```

## Death KM

```{r}
x <- res$survival_probability |>
  filter(outcome == "death_cohort") |>
  mutate(comparison_name = str_wrap(paste0(reference, " vs ", exposed), 20)) |>
  mutate(variable_level = as.integer(variable_level)) |>
  filter(comparison_id %in% c(3, 4, 5))

ggplot(data = x, aes(x = variable_level, y = survival, ymax = upper_survival, ymin = lower_survival, colour = cohort_name)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(weight_type ~ comparison_name) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

## Confounding

```{r}
x <- res$smd |>
  mutate(comparison_name = str_wrap(paste0(reference, " vs ", exposed), 20)) |>
  filter(!is.na(unbalanced)) |>
  mutate(variable_level = as.integer(variable_level)) |>
  mutate(col = if_else(variable_level > 360.5, "after", "before")) |>
  filter(comparison_id %in% c(3, 4, 5))

ggplot(data = x, aes(x = variable_level, y = unbalanced, colour = col)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(weight_type ~ comparison_name) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
